svg.title: Deals land on the midpoint of the first offers; the shift is in the opening
svg.desc: Scatter of every Study 2 deal against the midpoint of the two first offers, for Gemma 4 31B and Qwen; below, the x10^6 shift in seller share split into an opening and a concession channel for the Study 2 game and the information probe. Exploratory.
